mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_test_record ( user_id, course_id, section_id, question_id, question_category, question_type, content, knowledge_point, correct_answer, user_answer, is_correct, score, time_spent, test_batch_no, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{sectionId}, #{questionId}, #{questionCategory}, #{questionType}, #{content}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{correctAnswer}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, #{timeSpent}, #{testBatchNo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO question_test_record ( user_id, course_id, section_id, question_id, question_category, question_type, content, knowledge_point, correct_answer, user_answer, is_correct, score, time_spent, test_batch_no, create_time ) VALUES
( #{item.userId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.sectionId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.questionCategory}, #{item.questionType}, #{item.content}, #{item.knowledgePoint}, #{item.correctAnswer}, #{item.userAnswer}, #{item.isCorrect}, #{item.score}, #{item.timeSpent}, #{item.testBatchNo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_point AS knowledgePoint, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrongCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS accuracyRate, ROUND(AVG(time_spent), 2) AS avgTimeSpent FROM question_test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND section_id = #{sectionId} GROUP BY knowledge_point ORDER BY accuracyRate ASC

SELECT s.section_name AS sectionName, SUM(qtr.time_spent) AS totalTimeSpent, MIN(qtr.create_time) AS createTime, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN qtr.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS accuracyRate FROM question_test_record qtr LEFT JOIN section s ON qtr.section_id = s.id WHERE qtr.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY qtr.test_batch_no, qtr.section_id, s.section_name ORDER BY qtr.create_time DESC
